previous.changeLog:
Changes from 1.1.0 to 1.1.3:
• With modsList installed, Garage Audit is an entry in its list instead of the footer button. Without modsList, the button stays.
• The AUDIT button no longer shows a vehicle counter; the count is in the panel.
• Fixed: mode vehicles (Waffenträger, Steel Hunter, vehicles hidden in the current mode) no longer appear in the sections.
• Built for client 2.4.0.2.

current.changeLog:
• New sections: "Vehicle XP" (combat XP on garage and sold vehicles, elite status, free XP), "Incomplete ammo" (fewer shells than the gun holds), "Marks of excellence" (marks, percentage and mastery of tier V–XI vehicles in one table), "Crew members" (every crew member with battles, average XP and skills), "3D styles" (which 3D style is applied on each vehicle and which ones are unused).
• "Vehicle issues" is now a single table instead of five sections. The filter has an "Issue type" group so you can pick which issues to show.
• Hangar worth: a new "Exterior" row. It covers customisation in the depot that the game lets you sell for credits, with a price table and a "Type" filter.
• The panel opens from the mods list button in the Garage footer.
• The panel can be resized and the left menu scrolls.

previous.changeLog:
